title: Fixed Rocking Beam and Crank Handcar
description: One complete newly authored static railway pump-handcar appearance. Four complete flanged wheels on two continuous transverse axles support a low frame and paired long standing boards separated by a true central slot. Two open A-shaped pedestal supports carry a transverse pivot and one inclined full rocking beam with two wide transverse hand grips. An entire connecting rod descends through the deck gap to an offset front-axle crank and its real cross pin. This is not the old toolbox inspection trolley with a different push handle: the central open pumping structure and through-deck drive path are independently drawn. Three opaque constant PBR materials, metres, Z up and horizontal bounds-centred ground origin. No old vehicle or grindstone meshes imported. One prop, zero scenes; no person, track, rigging or animation. Static visual roots and overlaps only, not engineered bearings. No pumping, propulsion, gear ratio, travel, rail gauge compatibility, load, ergonomics, manufacture or operating safety claim.
